Claude Code 2.1.280 · ~/.claude.json

oauthAccount

  • object
  • 20 fields
  • personal data
  • refreshed daily

The account half of your login, fetched from Anthropic after /login. The tokens are not here: on macOS they sit in the Keychain, elsewhere in ~/.claude/.credentials.json. Most readers see this object only while Anthropic OAuth is the active auth, so it goes quiet under ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or a third-party provider. Deleted by /logout, which also runs before a login writes a different account.

Three sources fill it: /api/oauth/profile (identity, names, billing, trial), /api/oauth/claude_cli/roles (roles, organization name) and the bootstrap endpoint (organization type, rate-limit tiers). The profile is refetched at startup when it is older than 24 hours or missing fields. The email address is also placed in Claude's context every session, in a userEmail block binary. A save that would lose this object while memory still holds it is refused or repaired from memory.

Identity6 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
accountUuidstringYour Anthropic account id. Keys groveConfigCache and other per-account caches. binary
emailAddressstringYour account email. Shown in /status and "Logged in as", and placed in Claude's context each session. binary
displayNamestringProfile display name. binary
fullNamestringProfile full name. binary
accountCreatedAtstringWhen the account was created, ISO 8601. binary
profileFetchedAtintWhen the profile was last fetched, epoch ms; drives the 24-hour refresh. binary

Organization and roles8 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
organizationUuidstringThe active organization's id. Keys the per-organization caches; Remote Control needs it. binary
organizationNamestringThe organization's name. For a personal plan it is often built from your own name. binary
organizationTypestringPlan family from bootstrap: claude_pro, claude_max, claude_team, claude_enterprise. Not read elsewhere in 2.1.280. binary
organizationRolestringYour role in the organization; code compares admin, billing, owner, primary_owner. binary
workspaceRolenullConsole workspace role when there is one; code compares workspace_admin and workspace_billing. binary
organizationRateLimitTierstringThe organization's rate-limit tier from bootstrap. Not read elsewhere in 2.1.280. binary
userRateLimitTiernullPer-user rate-limit tier, when the server sets one. Not read elsewhere in 2.1.280. binary
seatTiernullOrganization seat tier, when set; code compares enterprise_usage_based. binary

Billing and trial6 keys

KeyTypeWhat it holds
billingTypestringHow the organization pays: usage-based, a Stripe or cloud-marketplace subscription, or an app-store subscription. Decides whether usage credits can be provisioned. binary
subscriptionCreatedAtstringWhen the subscription started, ISO 8601. Sent as a feature-flag targeting attribute. binary
hasExtraUsageEnabledboolThe organization has usage credits (paid usage beyond the plan) turned on; changes rate-limit messages. binary
claudeCodeTrialEndsAtnullEnd of a Claude Code Pro trial, ISO 8601, when one is running. binary
claudeCodeTrialDurationDaysnullTrial length the server grants, in days. binary
ccOnboardingFlags/objectempty in the sampleOrganization-level Claude Code onboarding flags from the profile. binary open →

Key names, types and presence counts were measured on one real ~/.claude.json (82 top-level keys, 72 project entries) on 28 September 2026; no value from that file is published here, and keys that are data (paths, UUIDs, names) are replaced by placeholders. Meanings are read from the Claude Code 2.1.280 binary binary, from Anthropic's documentation docs, or inferred from names and nearby code inferred. Undocumented keys can change in any release.
